chunks: With this chain, from al-Hasan, from Umar, from Aban, from Abi Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:

One who frequently recites Surah Maryam will not die until he attains that which makes him self-sufficient in his own self, wealth, and children; and in the Hereafter he will be among the companions of Isa, son of Maryam (peace be upon them), and he will be given in the Hereafter a kingdom like the worldly kingdom of Sulayman, son of Dawud (peace be upon them).
ai.seo_question: What are the rewards of frequently reciting Surah Maryam according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: Compiled by Shaykh al-Saduq in *Thawab al-A'mal*, this hadith emphasizes the transformative power of habitual recitation of Surah Maryam, linking it to comprehensive worldly sufficiency (*ghina*) and a unique eschatological status. The promise of being among the companions of Prophet Isa (AS) and receiving a kingdom akin to Prophet Sulayman (AS) underscores the Surah’s thematic focus on divine mercy, prophetic lineage, and resurrection, resonating with Shia traditions that view these prophets as key figures in the final judgment.

en.sayed-athar-husain-rizvi-&-sayed-maqs: 1. From the previous chain from al-Hassan from Umar from Aban from Abi Abdillah (a.s.) who said:

One who recites Surah Maryam regularly will not die till he is given that which makes him needless in himself, wealth and children; and in the hereafter he would be of the companions of Isa (a.s.) and in the hereafter he would be given a like of the worldly kingdom of Sulaiman bin Dawood (a.s.).
